i.norm: Verifies that {@link TaiInstant#withTaiSeconds(long)} keeps the nano-of-second unchanged while replacing the seconds, and that {@link TaiInstant#isBefore(TaiInstant)} correctly orders two instants that differ only by their seconds field.
ofTaiSeconds normalises the negative nano adjustment (-5) by borrowing one second, yielding seconds = -6 and nano-of-second = 999,999,995.
Replacing only the seconds (-6 -> -5) leaves the normalised nanos untouched.
The original instant (seconds = -6) lies before the new one (seconds = -5).
